summary: Ji-woo's midnight secret, the truth behind the sketchbook, Do-yoon's confession, why the siblings fought, and a plan for the first snow.

notes.title: -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다
notes.text: -는 척하다 means "pretend to": 자는 척해요 (he pretends to sleep), 모르는 척했어요 (pretended not to know). With adjectives or the past: 괜찮은 척 (pretending to be fine), 못 본 척 (pretending not to have seen). 자꾸 / 자꾸만 = again and again.

lessons.goal: Say "there's no way that…" with -(으)ㄹ 리가 없다.

scene.ko: 할머니, 사실은… 별이 누나가 저한테 편지로 그림을 보냈어요. 일 년 동안.
scene.en: Grandma, the truth is… Byeol has been mailing me drawings. For a whole year.
b: older sister (said by a boy or man)

scene.ko: 뭐라고? 별이가 너한테?
scene.en: What? Byeol sent them to you?

scene.ko: 누나는 이 집의 사물을 그렸어요. 커피 기계, 비, 손님… 그런 그림을 제가 스케치북에 넣었어요.
scene.en: She drew things around this house. The coffee machine, rain, a visitor… I put those drawings in the sketchbook.
b: older sister (said by a boy or man)

scene.ko: 그래서 그림이 미래를 보여 준 것 같았구나. 그림이 미래를 알 리가 없지.

to be like this (이렇게 = like this)

scene.ko: 이게 무어야… 그럼 그 그림 자체는 별이가 그렸어?
scene.en: What on earth… So the drawings themselves were done by Byeol?

scene.ko: 네. 누나 그림은 마음을 나타내요. 이 점이 제일 중요해요. 누나는 할머니를 걱정했어요.
scene.en: Yes. Her drawings show her heart. That's the most important part. She was worried about you, Grandma.
b: older sister (said by a boy or man)

scene.en: Oh my… She was thinking of me that much. I never knew she felt this way.

scene.ko: 저런 마음이 그런 그림이 됐어요. 그림 속에 사랑이 있어요.
scene.en: Feelings like that became those drawings. There's love inside them.
b: to become; to work, to be okay (돼요)

notes.title: -(으)ㄹ 리가 없다
notes.text: -(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 means "there's no way that…": 그림이 미래를 알 리가 없어요. A short, common version: 그럴 리가 없어! (No way!) 이렇게 / 그렇게 / 저렇게 = like this (near me) / like that (near you, or just mentioned) / like that (over there).

scene.en: That evening, Do-yoon comes to the boarding house. He sits across from Grandma.

scene.ko: 할머니, 이제 사실을 말씀드릴게요. 저는 별이 오빠예요.

scene.en: A year ago we had a big fight. I said something terrible. That's why Byeol left.

scene.ko: 매일 후회해요. 그때 제가 조금만 참았더라면… 별이가 지금 여기 있었을 거예요.
scene.en: I regret it every day. If only I had held my tongue then… Byeol would be here now.
b: to hold in, to put up with
to be (somewhere), there is, to have

scene.en: Oh, dear… Of course brothers and sisters fight. You must have each been hurting.
b: to be (somewhere), there is, to have

scene.ko: 그래서 하숙집 앞에 계속 왔어요?
scene.en: So that's why you kept coming by the boarding house?

scene.ko: 네. 별이를 찾는 일을 계속했어요. 그런데 제 자신이 부끄러워서 이야기를 못 했어요. 자신이 없었어요.
scene.en: Yes. I kept looking for Byeol. But I was ashamed of myself, so I couldn't tell anyone. I didn't have the confidence.
b: to not be, there isn't, to not have

scene.en: It's not the end of the world. Even the rain stops someday. Just don't let the fight go on.
b: to become; to work, to be okay (돼요)

scene.ko: 할머니 말씀이 당연해요. 이번 첫눈에 꼭 별이를 만나고 싶어요.
scene.en: You're right, Grandma. When the first snow comes, I really want to see Byeol.
b: the first snow of the year

notes.title: -았/었더라면
notes.text: -았/었더라면 voices regret about the past: 조금만 참았더라면… (if only I had held back a little…). It often pairs with -았/었을 거예요 (would have): 일찍 왔더라면 만났을 거예요 (if I'd come early, we would have met). 자신 means both "oneself" (自身) and "confidence" (自信).

lessons.goal: Talk about wants, complaints and what's right.

scene.ko: 도윤 씨, 왜 싸웠어요?
scene.en: Do-yoon, why did you two fight?

scene.ko: 아버지 공장 때문이에요. 저는 별이가 공장 일을 도와야 한다고 생각했어요. 그게 옳다고 믿었어요.
scene.en: Because of our father's factory. I thought Byeol should help with the factory. I believed that was right.

scene.ko: 별이는 웹툰이 꿈이었어요. 저는 앞뒤를 가리지 않고 반대했어요. 제 욕심이었어요.

to tell apart, to judge (앞뒤를 가리다)

scene.ko: 네. 그리고 별이는 콤플렉스가 있었어요. 자기 그림에 만족하지 못했어요. 겉으로는 웃었지만 속으로는 아팠어요.
scene.en: Yes. And Byeol had a complex. She was never satisfied with her drawings. She smiled on the outside, but inside she was hurting.

scene.ko: 사람마다 속도가 달라. 빨리 가는 사람도 있고, 천천히 가는 사람도 있어.

scene.en: Not too fast, not too slow — a moderate pace is just right. The middle way is what matters.

notes.title: Right and wrong
notes.text: 옳다 (to be right), 바르다 (to be upright, proper — 바른 자세 = good posture), 알맞다 / 적당하다 (to be just right). 겉 = the outside, 속 = the inside: 겉으로는 웃었지만 속으로는 울었어요 (smiling on the outside, crying inside). 욕심 = greed, wanting too much.

notes.title: Planning words
notes.text: 어떡해? (What do I do?) is the classic cry of every drama heroine. 아무래도 = "it seems… after all." 그렇지! = "That's it! / Right!" 신이 나다 = to be excited, to have a blast. 밥을 짓다 = to cook rice — 짓다 also means to build a house or write a poem.
